title: GUIDE: Generative Unsupervised Chinese Query Correction via Phonetic and Visual Shared-ID Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2608.25343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chinese query correction (CQC) is important for search and query recommendation on content platforms, but supervised methods rely on large annotated correction pairs that are costly to maintain as query vocabularies evolve. Unsupervised correction with language models is attractive, yet in the short-query setting, unconstrained generation often over-corrects ambiguous inputs toward high-frequency phrases, causing intent drift. We propose \textsc{GUIDE}, a generative unsupervised framework for CQC based on a confuse-then-clarify paradigm. \textsc{GUIDE} encodes phonetically or visually confusable characters with shared-IDs and reconstructs the original query with an encoder--decoder architecture, which constrains correction to plausible confusion neighborhoods while learning from unlabeled query streams. A time-decayed, query-frequency-weighted objective further supports adaptation to rapidly changing query vocabularies. Experiments on \t

translated_title: 指南：通过语音和视觉共享ID编码的生成式无监督中文查询纠错
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25343v1 公告类型：新  摘要：中文查询纠错（CQC）对于内容平台上的搜索和查询推荐至关重要，但监督方法依赖于大量带注释的纠错对，随着查询词汇的演变，维护成本高昂。基于语言模型的无监督纠错具有吸引力，但在短查询场景中，无约束生成往往会将模糊输入过度纠正为高频短语，导致意图漂移。我们提出\textsc{GUIDE}，一种基于“混淆-澄清”范式的生成式无监督CQC框架。\textsc{GUIDE}使用共享ID编码语音或视觉上易混淆的字符，并通过编码器-解码器架构重建原始查询，这在不依赖标记数据的情况下，将纠正限制在合理的混淆邻域内，同时从未标记的查询流中学习。一种时间衰减、查询频率加权的目标进一步支持对快速变化的查询词汇的适应。实验在\t
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为GUIDE的生成式无监督中文查询纠错框架，通过共享ID编码语音和视觉混淆字符，结合“混淆-澄清”范式，有效避免过度纠正导致的意图漂移，并适应快速变化的查询词汇。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GUIDE, a generative unsupervised Chinese query correction framework that encodes phonetically and visually confusable characters with shared IDs and adopts a confuse-then-clarify paradigm, effectively preventing intent drift from over-correction while adapting to rapidly evolving query vocabularies.
